purpose: Define deterministic, ephemeral, in-memory dry-run cases for Whale event identity, route linkage, deduplication, conflict handling, bounded reassessment, and terminal-state finality without creating permanent scripts, schemas, runtime bindings, or database mutations.
oracle_rules: Every assessment must terminate in exactly one terminal state.
No single evidence source may determine the final decision.
Economic route identity is created only after evidence synthesis, never at ingest.
Duplicate suppression must not destroy provenance.
Fragment aggregation requires linkage evidence, not amount sum alone.
Multi-hop principal value must be counted once per economic route.
Label conflict must remain explicit evidence and cannot be force-resolved.
Bounded reassessment may run at most once.
A reassessment produces a new assessment record and does not overwrite prior terminal history.

test_cases.input: Two records with identical chain, txid, transaction_index, source, destination, asset and amount.
Same underlying transfer represented by two source families with formatting or timestamp drift.
Two transfers between related wallets but with distinct txids and economically distinct values.
Multiple sub-threshold transfers linked by common controller evidence, common destination and bounded time relation.
Multiple sub-threshold transfers sharing only the same asset and time range.
Several linked source wallets converge on one destination with cluster and provenance support.
One source disperses value across several destinations.
Bridge ingress, intermediate routing and destination-chain egress represent one principal movement.
Large transfer between verified exchange-controlled wallets with no supported external market-impact evidence.
Static entity label indicates CEX while behavior and cluster evidence indicate suspicious fan-out.
Large event with missing liquidity, route depth and unresolved entity attribution after one bounded reassessment.
Assessment receives conflicting evidence and a timeout-like evidence gap.
Initial assessment ends REVIEW_REQUIRED and one additional evidence expansion is performed.
Same ordered fixture is evaluated twice under identical policy inputs.

failure_conditions: Any event produces more than one terminal state.
Multi-hop principal value is counted more than once.
Fragmented transfer is aggregated using amount sum alone.
A static label or one evidence source determines the final decision.
Any repository script, schema, runtime, panel, service, database or network mutation occurs.
